description: Before sending crypto: checks an EVM, Solana or Bitcoin address for a valid checksum, the right network, dead/burn/program addresses, a mismatch with the expected payee, and address-poisoning lookalikes of addresses you already trust. Live on-chain lookup: has the address ever been used, is it a wallet, contract or program. Returns pass / caution / fail with reasons. Price: $0.01 USDC per call after 25 free calls per day.

_payment.description: x402 v2 payment: base64 PaymentPayload, as you would send in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Only needed after the free allowance is used.

address.description: The address you are about to pay.

expected.description: Optional. The address you were told to pay, e.g. from an invoice.

known.description: Optional. Addresses you have paid or trust before (max 200). GET: comma-separated.

network.description: Optional. Network you intend to use.

name: address_check
title: Payment address check
